pipeline.runs:
# Ensure package.version has three parts (e.g., 27.0.0) so that art
# version-stream automation does not reject it as a major-only version.
ver="${{package.version}}"
parts=$(echo "$ver" | tr '.' '\n' | wc -l)
if [ "$parts" -lt 3 ]; then
  echo "ERROR: package.version '$ver' must have at least three parts (e.g., 27.0.0)"
  exit 1
fi

pipeline.name: Fetch the locked source commit
pipeline.runs:
git init -q .
for delay in 0 15 45; do
  sleep "$delay"
  for source in https://github.com/openjdk/jdk27u.git https://github.com/openjdk/jdk.git; do
    if git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c fetch.fsckObjects=true fetch --no-tags --depth=1 "$source" 360190464fafe7f6dc53b87304aef715b8d96920; then
      test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 360190464fafe7f6dc53b87304aef715b8d96920
      git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null checkout -q --detach 360190464fafe7f6dc53b87304aef715b8d96920
      exit 0
    fi
  done
done
echo "360190464fafe7f6dc53b87304aef715b8d96920: every source failed, three times" >&2
exit 1

pipeline.name: Apply Werewolf policy patches
pipeline.runs:
while IFS= read -r name; do
  patch -p1 --forward --batch --fuzz=2 --no-backup-if-mismatch -i "werewolf/patches/$name" || exit 1
done < werewolf/patches/series

pipeline.name: Permit effective root only in the build guest
pipeline.runs:
mkdir -p /etc/runtime-hardening
: > /etc/runtime-hardening/build-root
chmod 600 /etc/runtime-hardening/build-root
# The build runs its own tools with the JDK it builds, from the
# writable build tree.
mkdir -p /etc/runtime-hardening/allow/all/java
: > /etc/runtime-hardening/allow/all/java/writable-source

_java_bin="./build/*-server-release/images/jdk/bin"

# Check we built something valid
$_java_bin/javac -d . HelloWorld.java
$_java_bin/java HelloWorld

# run the gtest unittest suites
# Temporarily disable G1HeapRegion.apply_to_marked_object_other_vm
# due to a segfault that's been reported to (but
# not acknowledged yet by) upstream.
make test-hotspot-gtest \
  GTEST='OPTIONS=--gtest_filter=-G1HeapRegion.apply_to_marked_object_other_vm'

_java_home="usr/lib/jvm/java-${{vars.java-version}}-openjdk"

mkdir -p "${{targets.destdir}}"/$_java_home
cp -r build/*-server-release/images/jdk/* "${{targets.destdir}}"/$_java_home
rm "${{targets.destdir}}"/$_java_home/lib/src.zip

# symlink to shared java cacerts store
rm -f "${{targets.contextdir}}"/$_java_home/lib/security/cacerts
ln -sf /etc/ssl/certs/java/cacerts \
  "${{targets.contextdir}}"/$_java_home/lib/security/cacerts
# symlink for `java-common` to work (which expects jre in $_java_home/jre)
ln -sf . "${{targets.contextdir}}/$_java_home/jre"

pipeline.name: Remove demos before packaging the JDK

pipeline.runs:
_java_home="usr/lib/jvm/java-${{vars.java-version}}-openjdk"

mkdir -p "${{targets.subpkgdir}}"/$_java_home
cp -r build/*-server-release/images/jre/* "${{targets.subpkgdir}}"/$_java_home

# symlink to shared java cacerts store
rm -f "${{targets.subpkgdir}}"/$_java_home/lib/security/cacerts
ln -sf /etc/ssl/certs/java/cacerts \
  "${{targets.subpkgdir}}"/$_java_home/lib/security/cacerts

# symlink for `java-common` to work (which expects jre in $_java_home/jre)
ln -sf . "${{targets.subpkgdir}}/$_java_home/jre"

# check that jdk.crypto.ec is included in image
${{targets.destdir}}/$_java_home/bin/jimage list "${{targets.subpkgdir}}"/$_java_home/lib/modules | grep "Module: jdk.crypto.ec"

subpackages.name: ${{package.name}}-default-jvm
subpackages.description: Use the openjdk-${{vars.java-version}} JVM as the default JVM

subpackages.name: ${{package.name}}-default-jdk
subpackages.description: Use the openjdk-${{vars.java-version}} JVM as the default JVM with the JDK installed

pipeline.runs:
set -euo pipefail
javac HelloWorld.java
java HelloWorld | grep -Fi "Hello World!"

set -euo pipefail
javac RequestTest.java
java RequestTest | grep -Fi "Successfully connected to example.org"

mkdir output
javac -d output --module-source-path modules $(find modules -name "*.java")

# Create a jar with the compiled classes
jar --verbose --create --file app.jar \
  --main-class dev.chainguard.module.main.Main \
  --module-version 1.0 \
  -C output/test.modules . \
  -C output/main.app .

# Test the jar
java -jar app.jar

# Test jlink
jlink --verbose --module-path "app.jar" \
  --add-modules test.modules \
  --output test-project-jre

# Test custom JRE
test-project-jre/bin/java -jar app.jar
